According to the minister, Israeli soldiers entered classrooms and filmed propaganda footage in the presence of students. Karami clarified that the incident occurred more than a month ago without the ministry’s knowledge and announced that the ministry would follow up with the relevant authorities, condemning the use of children and educational institutions for military and media purposes.

Visioner BIG | 🇮🇱 🇮🇷 🇱🇧 🇵🇸 🇸🇾 ‼️ ‼️ Israeli military intelligence has warned that an Israeli strike against Iran could trigger a wider regional conflict, potentially opening additional fronts in Gaza, Lebanon, and Syria, according to Channel 12. The IDF’s Military Intelligence Directorate reportedly presented its assessment to senior Israeli officials, warning that military action against Tehran might provoke escalation across multiple theaters. The assessment contradicts Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s assertions and other reports suggesting that an Israeli strike on Iran would result in a limited confrontation lasting only a few days. The warning highlights the danger of assuming that a confrontation with Iran could remain geographically contained. Escalation across several fronts would force Israel to divide its military resources between multiple operational theaters while placing additional pressure on air defenses and civilian infrastructure. The disagreement also raises serious questions about the risks underlying Israel’s strategic planning toward Tehran. See the latest updates with us: @visionergeo tweet
